ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app requires microphone access to process voice input or recording. By processing your voice, we can provide voice commands or recording features. You can revoke this permission at any time in Settings.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This app would like to request permission to track your activity across other companies' apps and websites to provide personalized ads. By understanding your interests, we can provide more relevant advertisements. You can revoke this permission at any time in Settings.
